title: Mapped Objects: one ooRexx object over several tables
purpose: packages/oorexx_mapped_objects_v0.1: an ooRexx class mapped with ::ANNOTATE over several NoSQLServer tables (values, extension tables, one, many, link many, ownership), a session with an identity map and one-transaction commits, and graph lines for the Database Lab. Read before mapping a class, binding a designer dialog, or drawing a database graph.
